units.zh: 英宗體乾應曆隆功盛德憲文肅武睿聖宣孝皇帝，諱曙，濮安懿王允讓第十三子，母曰仙游縣君任氏。
units.en: Emperor Yingzong—full style from Aligning with Heaven through Proclaiming Filiality—personal name Shu, was the thirteenth son of Prince of Pu’an Yunrang; his mother was Lady Ren of Xianyou.
units.literal: Emperor Yingzong, entitled Aligning with Heaven, Responding to the Calendar, Lofty Merit, Abundant Virtue, Constituting Culture, Solemn Martiality, Sagacious Governance, Proclaiming Filiality, taboo name Shu, was the thirteenth son of Prince of Pu’an the Respectful Wang Yunrang; his mother was Lady Ren, county mistress of Xianyou.

units.zh: 明道元年正月三日生於宣平坊第。
units.en: Bright Path 1, third of the first month: he was born at the Xuanping mansion.
units.literal: In the first year of Bright Path, first month, third day, he was born at the Xuanping ward residence.

units.zh: 初，王夢兩龍與日並墮，以衣承之。
units.en: His father dreamed two dragons and the sun falling into his robes.
units.literal: At first the prince dreamed two dragons and the sun fell together; he caught them in his robe.

units.zh: 及帝生，赤光滿室，或見黃龍遊光中。
units.en: At his birth red light filled the room; some saw a yellow dragon in the glare.
units.literal: When the emperor was born, red light filled the chamber; some saw a yellow dragon moving in the glow.

units.zh: 四歲，仁宗養於內。
units.en: At four he was raised in the palace by Renzong.
units.literal: At four sui he was raised in the inner palace by Renzong.

units.zh: 寶元二年，豫王生，乃歸濮邸。
units.en: Precious Origin 2, when Prince Yu was born, he returned to the Pu mansion.
units.literal: In the second year of Precious Origin, when Prince Yu was born, he returned to the Pu residence.

units.zh: 帝天性篤孝，好讀書，不爲燕嬉褻慢，服御儉素如儒者。
units.en: He was deeply filial, bookish, never frivolous or rude, and dressed as plainly as a scholar.
units.literal: By nature he was deeply filial, loved reading, did not indulge in frivolous amusement or disrespect, and dressed plainly like a scholar.

units.zh: 每以朝服見教授，曰：「師也，敢弗爲禮？」
units.en: Meeting his tutor in court dress he said, “You are my teacher—I must show full ritual.”
units.literal: Whenever he met his tutor in court dress he said: “You are my teacher—how dare I not show ritual?”

units.zh: 時吳王宮教授吳充進《宗室六箴》，仁宗付宗正，帝書之屏風以自戒。
units.en: Wu Chong’s Six Admonitions for the Clan were set on his screen as a daily warning.
units.literal: At the time Wu Chong, tutor of the Wu prince’s palace, presented the Six Admonitions for the Imperial Clan; Renzong gave them to the clan court and the emperor wrote them on a screen for self-warning.

units.zh: 景祐三年，賜名宗實，授左監門衛率府副率，累遷右羽林軍大將軍、宜州刺史。
units.en: In Jingyou 3 he received the name Zongshi and was appointed deputy commandant in the Left Palace Gate Guard; he later rose to Great General of the Right Feathered Forest Army and prefectural military commissioner of Yi Prefecture.
units.literal: In the third year of Jingyou he was given the name Zongshi and appointed deputy commandant of the Left Palace Gate Guard command, later rising through the ranks to Great General of the Right Feathered Forest Army and prefectural military commissioner of Yi Prefecture.

units.zh: 皇祐二年，爲右衛大將軍、岳州團練使。
units.en: Imperial Blessing 2: right guard general and Yue commander.
units.literal: In the second year of Imperial Blessing he was great general of the right guard and regimental commander of Yue prefecture.

units.zh: 嘉祐中，宰相韓琦等請建儲，仁宗曰：「宗子已有賢知可付者，卿等其勿憂。」
units.en: Jiayou: Han Qi urged naming an heir; Renzong said, "Among the imperial sons there is already one of worthy knowledge who can be entrusted—you need not worry."
units.literal: In the Jiayou era chief minister Han Qi and others asked to establish an heir; Renzong said: “Among the imperial sons there is already one of worthy knowledge who can be entrusted—you need not worry.”

units.zh: 時帝方服濮王喪。
units.en: He was then mourning Prince of Pu’an.
units.literal: At the time the emperor was in mourning for the Prince of Pu’an.

units.zh: 六年十月辛卯，起爲秦州防禦使、知宗正寺，帝以終喪辭。
units.en: Year six, tenth month, xinmao: he was recalled as defense commissioner of Qin Prefecture and administrator of the Court of the Imperial Clan, but declined because his mourning was not complete.
units.literal: Sixth year, tenth month, day xinmao: he was raised as defense commissioner of Qin and director of the imperial clan court; the emperor declined on grounds of unfinished mourning.

units.zh: 奏四上，乃聽。
units.en: Four memorials later, he was allowed to refuse.
units.literal: He memorialized four times; only then was he heard.

units.zh: 喪終，復授前命，又辭。
units.en: After mourning the same posts returned; he refused again.
units.literal: When mourning ended, the former appointment was renewed; he again declined.

units.zh: 七年八月，許罷宗正，復爲岳州團練使。
units.en: Year seven, eighth month: he left the clan court and returned to Yue command.
units.literal: Seventh year, eighth month: he was permitted to leave the clan court and again became regimental commander of Yue.

units.zh: 戊寅，立爲皇子。
units.en: On wuyin, he was made imperial son.
units.literal: Day wuyin: he was established as imperial son.

units.zh: 癸未，改今名。
units.en: On guiwei, he received his present name Shu.
units.literal: Day guiwei: his present name was given.

units.zh: 帝聞詔稱疾，益堅辭。
units.en: On hearing the edict he pleaded illness and refused harder.
units.literal: Hearing the edict, he claimed illness and declined more firmly.

units.zh: 詔同判大宗正事安國公從古等往喻旨，即臥內起帝以入。
units.en: Conggu and others were sent to explain; they lifted him from his bed and brought him in.
units.literal: Edict: Co-director of the great clan court Duke of Anguo Conggu and others were sent to explain the intent; they raised the emperor from his bed and brought him in.

units.zh: 甲辰，見清居殿。
units.en: On jiachen, he appeared at Qingju Hall.
units.literal: Day jiachen: he was received at Qingju Hall.

units.zh: 自是，日再朝，或入侍禁中。
units.en: Thereafter he attended twice daily or served in the inner palace.
units.literal: From then on he attended court twice daily or entered to serve in the inner palace.

units.zh: 九月，遷齊州防禦使、鉅鹿郡公。
units.en: Ninth month: he became Qi defense commissioner and Duke of Julu.
units.literal: Ninth month: he was moved to defense commissioner of Qi and Duke of Julu.

units.zh: 八年，仁宗崩。
units.en: Year eight: Renzong died.
units.literal: Year eight: Renzong died.

units.zh: 夏四月壬申朔，皇后傳遺詔，命帝嗣皇帝位。
units.en: Fourth month, new moon renshen: the empress’s will made him emperor.
units.literal: Summer, fourth month, day renshen new moon: the empress transmitted the testament and ordered the emperor to succeed to the throne.

units.zh: 百官入，哭盡哀。
units.en: The bureaucracy entered and wept.
units.literal: All officials entered and wept their fill.

units.zh: 韓琦宣遺制。
units.en: Han Qi read the testament.
units.literal: Han Qi announced the testament provisions.

units.zh: 帝御東楹見百官。
units.en: He received officials at the eastern pillar.
units.literal: The emperor received officials at the eastern pillar.

units.zh: 癸酉，大赦，賜百官爵一等，優賞諸軍，如乾興故事。
units.en: On guiyou, amnesty, rank gifts, and army rewards followed Qianxing precedent.
units.literal: Day guiyou: great amnesty; officials received one degree of noble rank; armies richly rewarded, as in the Qianxing precedent.

units.zh: 遣王道恭告哀於契丹。
units.en: Wang Daogong told the Khitan of Renzong’s death.
units.literal: Wang Daogong was sent to announce mourning to the Khitan.

units.zh: 帝欲亮陰三年，命韓琦攝冢宰，宰臣不可，乃止。
units.en: He wanted three years of mourning; Han Qi as acting ritual chief was blocked by the cabinet.
units.literal: The emperor wished three years of bright mourning; Han Qi was ordered acting chief of rites; chief ministers objected and it was stopped.

units.zh: 乙亥，帝不豫。
units.en: On yihai, the emperor sickened.
units.literal: Day yihai: the emperor was unwell.

units.zh: 遣韓贄等告即位於契丹。
units.en: Han Zan announced the accession to the Khitan.
units.literal: Han Zan and others were sent to announce the accession to the Khitan.

units.zh: 丙子，尊皇后曰皇太后。
units.en: On bingzi, the empress became dowager.
units.literal: Day bingzi: the empress was honored as empress dowager.

units.zh: 己卯，詔請皇太后同聽政。
units.en: On jimao, the dowager was asked to co-rule.
units.literal: Day jimao, edict: the empress dowager was asked to hear government jointly.

units.zh: 壬午，皇太后御小殿垂簾，宰臣覆奏事。
units.en: On renwu, the dowager screened the small hall while ministers reported.
units.literal: Day renwu: the empress dowager held the curtain at the small hall; chief ministers reported affairs.

units.zh: 乙酉，作受命寶。
units.en: On yiyou, the Mandate-receiving seal was cast.
units.literal: Day yiyou: the Mandate-receiving seal was made.

units.zh: 丁亥，以皇子右千牛衛將軍仲鍼爲安州觀察使、光國公。
units.en: On dinghai, Zhongzhen became An commissioner and Duke of Guangguo.
units.literal: Day dinghai: the imperial son’s right thousand-oxen general Zhongzhen was made observation commissioner of An and Duke of Guangguo.

units.zh: 熒惑自七年八月庚辰不見，命宰臣祈禳，至是月己丑見於東方。
units.en: Mars unseen since year seven, eighth month—after prayers it reappeared in the east this month on jichou.
units.literal: Mars had not been seen since eighth month, day gengchen of the seventh year; chief ministers prayed; this month, day jichou, it appeared in the east.

units.zh: 庚子，立京兆郡君高氏爲皇后。
units.en: On gengzi, Lady Gao of Jingzhao became empress.
units.literal: Day gengzi: Lady Gao of Jingzhao commandery was established as empress.

units.zh: 五月戊午，以富弼爲樞密使。
units.en: Fifth month, wuwu: Fu Bi took military affairs.
units.literal: Fifth month, day wuwu: Fu Bi was made military affairs commissioner.

units.zh: 戊辰，初御延和殿。
units.en: On wuchen, he first sat in Yanhe Hall.
units.literal: Day wuchen: for the first time he held court at Yanhe Hall.

units.zh: 以疾未平，命宰臣祈福於天地、宗廟、社稷及寺觀，又祈于嶽瀆名山。
units.en: Still ill, ministers prayed at Heaven, Earth, temple, altars, monasteries, and sacred rivers.
units.literal: Because illness was not yet settled, chief ministers were ordered to pray at Heaven, Earth, the ancestral temple, the altars of soil and grain, and monasteries and abbeys; also at famous peaks and rivers.

units.zh: 六月辛卯，契丹遣蕭福延等來祭吊。
units.en: Sixth month, xinmao: Khitan mourners arrived.
units.literal: Sixth month, day xinmao: the Khitan sent Xiao Fuyan and others to mourn and console.

units.zh: 秋七月壬子，初御紫宸殿。
units.en: Seventh month, renzi: he first held court in Zichen Hall.
units.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day renzi: for the first time he held court at Zichen Hall.

units.zh: 帝自六月癸酉不御殿，至是始見百官。
units.en: Since sixth month guiyou he had not held court; now he received ministers.
units.literal: The emperor had not held court since sixth month, day guiyou; only now did he see officials.

units.zh: 癸亥，歲星晝見。
units.en: On guihai, Jupiter shone in daylight.
units.literal: Day guihai: Jupiter appeared by day.

units.zh: 乙丑，星大小數百西流。
units.en: On yichou, hundreds of stars streamed west.
units.literal: Day yichou: hundreds of stars large and small streamed westward.

units.zh: 戊辰，百官請大行皇帝諡于南郊。
units.en: On wuchen, ministers sought Renzong’s posthumous title at the southern suburb.
units.literal: Day wuchen: officials requested the late emperor’s posthumous title at the southern suburb.

units.zh: 八月癸巳，以生日爲壽聖節。
units.en: Eighth month, guisi: his birthday became Shousheng festival day.
units.literal: Eighth month, day guisi: his birthday was established as the Shousheng festival.

units.zh: 九月辛亥，以光國公仲鍼爲忠武軍節度使、同中書門下平章事、淮陽郡王，改名頊。
units.en: Ninth month, xinhai: Zhongzhen became Zhongwu commissioner, chancellor, Huaiyang prince, and took the name Xu.
units.literal: Ninth month, day xinhai: Guangguo Duke Zhongzhen was made Zhongwu military commissioner, co-chancellor of the Secretariat and Chancellor's Office, Prince of Huaiyang, and renamed Xu.

units.zh: 戊午，上仁宗諡冊于福寧殿。
units.en: On wuwu, Renzong's posthumous title was read in Funing Hall.
units.literal: Day wuwu: Renzong's posthumous title and book were presented at Funing Hall.

units.zh: 冬十月甲午，葬仁宗於永昭陵。
units.en: Tenth month, jiawu: Renzong was buried at Yongzhao.
units.literal: Winter, tenth month, day jiawu: Renzong was buried at Yongzhao Tomb.

units.zh: 十一月丙午，祔於太廟。
units.en: Eleventh month, bingwu: Renzong entered the ancestral temple.
units.literal: Eleventh month, day bingwu: he was enshrined in the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

units.zh: 大風霾。
units.en: Great dust storms swept the land.
units.literal: Great wind and dust storms.

units.zh: 己酉，減東西二京罪囚一等，免山陵役戶及靈駕所過民租。
units.en: On jiyou, capital prisoners won one grade of relief; tomb corvée and spirit-route rents were forgiven.
units.literal: Day jiyou: prisoners in the eastern and western capitals had sentences reduced one degree; corvée households of the imperial tomb and rent on communities along the spirit route were remitted.

units.zh: 辛亥，契丹遣蕭素等來賀即位。
units.en: On xinhai, Khitan envoys came for the accession.
units.literal: Day xinhai: Khitan sent Xiao Su and others to congratulate the accession.

units.zh: 十二月己巳，初御邇英閣，召侍臣講讀經史。
units.en: Twelfth month, jisi: he first sat at Ziyi Pavilion for classic lectures.
units.literal: Twelfth month, day jisi: for the first time he held court at the Ziyi Pavilion and summoned attendant officials to lecture on the classics and histories.

units.zh: 乙亥，淮陽郡王頊出閣。
units.en: On yihai, Huaiyang prince Xu left the inner quarters.
units.literal: Day yihai: Prince of Huaiyang Xu left the palace.

units.zh: 是歲，於闐、西南蕃來貢。
units.en: That year, Khotan and southwestern peoples paid tribute.
units.literal: That year, Khotan and the southwestern tribes came with tribute.

units.zh: 治平元年春正月丁酉朔，改元。
units.en: Zhiping 1, first month new moon dingyou: a new reign era began.
units.literal: Zhiping 1, spring, first month, day dingyou new moon: the era name was changed.

units.zh: 戊戌，太白晝見。
units.en: On wuxu, Venus shone in daylight.
units.literal: Day wuxu: Venus appeared by day.

units.zh: 己亥，壽聖節，百官及契丹使初上壽於紫宸殿。
units.en: On jihai, Shousheng Day—the court and Khitan envoys first offered longevity in Zichen Hall.
units.literal: Day jihai: Shousheng festival; officials and Khitan envoys for the first time offered longevity congratulations in Zichen Hall.

units.zh: 甲寅，賞知唐州趙尚寬修溝堰、增戶口，進一官，賜錢二十萬。
units.en: On jiayin, Tang prefect Zhao Shangkuan, who had dredged canals and grown the registers, won a rank and two hundred thousand cash.
units.literal: Day jiayin: Zhao Shangkuan of Tang prefecture was rewarded for repairing canals and increasing household registers—one step in rank and two hundred thousand cash.

units.zh: 三月壬寅，命修秦悼王塚，置守護官。
units.en: Third month, renyin: the tomb of the Qin Mourning Prince was restored and staffed with guardians.
units.literal: Third month, day renyin: Prince Zhao's tomb was repaired and guardian officials set.

units.zh: 戊午，錄囚。
units.en: On wuwu, prisoners were reviewed.
units.literal: Day wuwu: prisoners were reviewed.

units.zh: 辛酉，雨土。
units.en: On xinyou, earth fell from the sky.
units.literal: Day xinyou: earth rained from the sky.

units.zh: 夏四月癸未，放宮女百三十五人。
units.en: Fourth month, guiwei: one hundred thirty-five palace women were set free.
units.literal: Summer, fourth month, day guiwei: one hundred thirty-five palace women were released.

units.zh: 甲午，祈雨于相國天清寺、醴泉觀。
units.en: On jiawu, rain prayers were held at Tianqing and Liquan.
units.literal: Day jiawu: rain was prayed for at Xiangguo Tianqing Monastery and Liquan Abbey.

units.zh: 賜諸軍錢有差。
units.en: The armies received graded cash gifts.
units.literal: The armies were granted cash in varying amounts.

units.zh: 五月己亥，浚二股河。
units.en: Fifth month, jihai: the Two-Channel River was dredged.
units.literal: Fifth month, day jihai: the Two-Channel River was dredged.

units.zh: 戊申，皇太后還政。
units.en: On wushen, the dowager handed back rule.
units.literal: Day wushen: the empress dowager returned government.

units.zh: 庚戌，初日御前後殿。
units.en: On gengxu, he first held day and night court in the front and rear halls.
units.literal: Day gengxu: for the first time he held court day and night at the front and rear halls.

units.zh: 壬子，詔：「皇太后稱聖旨，出入儀衛如章獻太后故事。
units.en: On renzi: the dowager was to be styled by "sacred decree," with Zhangxian-era escort.
units.literal: Day renzi, edict: "The empress dowager shall be addressed by 'sacred decree'; her coming and going guard shall follow the precedent of Empress Dowager Zhangxian.

units.zh: 其有所須，內侍錄聖旨付有司，覆奏即行。」
units.en: Her requests went by eunuch-recorded sacred decree to the offices, then straight to execution after report."
units.literal: Whatever she required, eunuchs were to record the sacred decree and hand it to the appropriate office; after reporting back it was to be carried out."

units.zh: 丙辰，上皇太后宮殿名曰慈壽。
units.en: On bingchen, the dowager's palace was named Cishou.
units.literal: Day bingchen: the empress dowager's palace was named Cishou.

units.zh: 己未，熒惑犯太微上將。
units.en: On jiwei, Mars crossed the Supreme Palace's Grand Marshal.
units.literal: Day jiwei: Mars invaded the Grand Marshal star of the Supreme Palace Enclosure.

units.zh: 壬戌，以病癒，命宰臣謝天地、宗廟、社稷及宮觀。
units.en: On renxu, recovered, he ordered thanks at Heaven, temple, altars, and abbeys.
units.literal: Day renxu: because illness had eased, ministers were ordered to thank Heaven, Earth, the ancestral temple, the altars, and monasteries.

units.zh: 閏月戊辰，輔臣進爵一等。
units.en: Intercalary sixth month, wuchen: the chief ministers rose one rank.
units.literal: Intercalary sixth month, day wuchen: chief ministers were advanced one step in noble rank.

units.zh: 六月己亥，以淮陽郡王頊爲潁王，祁國公顥爲保甯軍節度使、同中書門下平章事、東陽郡王，鄠國公頵爲左衛上將軍。
units.en: Sixth month, jihai: Xu became Ying prince; Hao became Baoning commissioner and Dongyang prince; Yun became left guard senior general.
units.literal: Sixth month, day jihai: Prince of Huaiyang Xu was made Prince of Ying; Duke of Qi Guo Hao was made Baoning military commissioner, co-chancellor, Prince of Dongyang; Duke of E Guo Yun was made left guard senior general.

units.zh: 增宗室教授。
units.en: More tutors were added for the imperial clan.
units.literal: Clan instructors were increased.

units.zh: 丁未，增同知大宗正事一員。
units.en: On dingwei, the great clan court gained another co-director.
units.literal: Day dingwei: one additional co-director of the great clan court was added.

units.zh: 辛亥，作睦親、廣親宅。
units.en: On xinhai, the Mujin and Guangqin mansions were built.
units.literal: Day xinhai: the Mujin and Guangqin residences were built.

units.zh: 辛酉，太白晝見。
units.en: On xinyou, Venus shone in daylight.
units.literal: Day xinyou: Venus appeared by day.

units.zh: 壬戌，歲星晝見。
units.en: On renxu, Jupiter shone in daylight.
units.literal: Day renxu: Jupiter appeared by day.

units.zh: 八月甲辰，錄周世宗後。
units.en: Eighth month, jiachen: survivors of Later Zhou Shizong were enrolled.
units.literal: Eighth month, day jiachen: the descendants of Later Zhou Shizong were recorded.

units.zh: 甲寅，太白入太微垣。
units.en: On jiayin, Venus entered the Supreme Palace Enclosure.
units.literal: Day jiayin: Venus entered the Supreme Palace Enclosure.

units.zh: 乙卯，遣兵部員外郎呂誨等四人充賀契丹太后生辰、正旦使，刑部郎中章岷等四人充賀契丹主生辰、正旦使。
units.en: On yimao, Lu Hui's party would greet the Khitan dowager; Zhang Min's party, the Khitan emperor.
units.literal: Day yimao: Ministry of War vice director Lu Hui and three others were sent as envoys to congratulate the Khitan empress dowager's birthday and New Year's Day; Ministry of Punishments director Zhang Min and three others as envoys to congratulate the Khitan emperor's birthday and New Year's Day.

units.zh: 丙辰，內侍都知任守忠坐不法，貶保信軍節度副使、蘄州安置。
units.en: On bingchen, eunuch Ren Shouzhong fell for misconduct to a Qizhou exile post.
units.literal: Day bingchen: Chief eunuch Ren Shouzhong, guilty of unlawful conduct, was demoted to Baoxin military deputy commissioner and assigned to Qizhou.

units.zh: 丁巳，以上供米三萬石振宿、亳二州水災戶。
units.en: On dingsi, thirty thousand piculs of tribute grain fed Suzhou and Bozhou flood victims.
units.literal: Day dingsi: thirty thousand piculs of tribute grain were used to relieve flood victims in Suzhou and Bozhou.

units.zh: 九月丁卯，復武舉。
units.en: Ninth month, dingmao: the military exam was restored.
units.literal: Ninth month, day dingmao: the military examination was restored.

units.zh: 庚午，詔夏國精擇使人，戒勵毋紊彝章。
units.en: On gengwu, Xia was told to send proper envoys and keep to ritual.
units.literal: Day gengwu, edict: Western Xia was to choose envoys with care and be warned not to disturb ritual propriety.

units.zh: 冬十月丙申，詔中外近臣、監司舉治行素著可備升擢者二人。
units.en: Tenth month, bingshen: near-throne officials were to nominate two proven administrators each.
units.literal: Winter, tenth month, day bingshen, edict: court and provincial officials near the throne were to recommend two of outstanding governance for promotion.

units.zh: 十一月乙亥，科陝西戶三丁之一，刺以爲義勇軍，凡十三萬八千四百六十五人，各賜錢二千。
units.en: Eleventh month, yihai: one in three Shaanxi men became Brave Righteous troops—138,465 men, each paid two thousand cash.
units.literal: Eleventh month, day yihai: one of every three Shaanxi households was levied as Brave Righteous Army—one hundred thirty-eight thousand four hundred sixty-five men in all, each given two thousand cash.

units.zh: 諫官司馬光累上疏諫之，不允。
units.en: Sima Guang protested again and again; the throne would not yield.
units.literal: Remonstrance official Sima Guang repeatedly memorialized against it; it was not allowed.

units.zh: 戊寅，復內侍養子令。
units.en: On wuyin, eunuchs could adopt sons again.
units.literal: Day wuyin: the eunuch adoption rule was restored.

units.zh: 十二月乙巳，雨土。
units.en: Twelfth month, yisi: earth fell from the sky.
units.literal: Twelfth month, day yisi: earth rained from the sky.

units.zh: 丙辰，契丹遣耶律烈等來賀壽聖節，蕭禧等來賀明年正旦。
units.en: On bingchen, Khitan envoys came for Shousheng and for New Year's Day.
units.literal: Day bingchen: Khitan sent Yelü Lie and others to congratulate Shousheng festival; Xiao Xi and others to congratulate next year's New Year's Day.

units.zh: 是歲，畿內、宋、亳、陳、許、汝、蔡、唐、潁、曹、濮、濟、單、濠、泗、廬、壽、楚、杭、宣、洪、鄂、施、渝州、光化、高郵軍大水，遣使行視，疏治振恤，蠲其賦租。
units.en: That year, great floods struck the capital circuit; Song, Bo, Chen, Xu, Ru, Cai, Tang, Ying, Cao, Pu, Ji, Shan, Hao, Si, Lu, Shou, Chu, Hang, Xuan, Hong, E, Shi, and Yu prefectures; and the Guanghua and Gaoyou armies. Envoys were sent to inspect, dredge channels, provide relief, and remit rents and taxes.
units.literal: That year, the capital region and Song, Bozhou, Chen, Xu, Ru, Cai, Tang, Ying, Cao, Pu, Ji, Shan, Hao, Si, Lu, Shou, Chu, Hang, Xuan, Hong, E, Shi, Yu prefectures, Guanghua and Gaoyou armies suffered great floods; envoys were sent to inspect, dredge, relieve, and remit grain rent.

units.zh: 西蕃瞎氊子瞎欺米征內附。
units.en: Zha Qimizheng, son of the western tribesman Zha Zhan, came in to submit.
units.literal: The western tribes' Zhaizi Zha Qimizheng came to submit.

units.zh: 二年春正月甲戌，振蔡州。
units.en: Year two, first month, jiaxu: Cai was relieved.
units.literal: Year two, spring, first month, day jiaxu: Cai prefecture was relieved.

units.zh: 二月甲辰，大風，晝冥。
units.en: Second month, jiachen: a windstorm darkened noon.
units.literal: Second month, day jiachen: great wind; day turned dark at noon.

units.zh: 丁未，錄囚。
units.en: On dingwei, prisoners were reviewed.
units.literal: Day dingwei: prisoners were reviewed.

units.zh: 是月，賜禮部奏名進士、明經諸科及第出身三百六十一人。
units.en: That month, 361 degree-holders from jinshi and classics routes received posts.
units.literal: That month: three hundred sixty-one men who passed the jinshi, classics, and various routes were granted rank and initial appointment.

units.zh: 三月己巳，班《明天曆》。
units.en: Third month, jisi: the Tomorrow Calendar was issued.
units.literal: Third month, day jisi: the Tomorrow Calendar was promulgated.

units.zh: 夏四月戊戌，詔議崇奉濮安懿王典禮。
units.en: Fourth month, wuxu: the court was to debate rites for Prince of Pu'an Yi.
units.literal: Summer, fourth month, day wuxu, edict: rites for honoring Prince of Pu'an Yi were to be debated.

units.zh: 辛丑，詔監司、知州歲薦吏毋徒充數。
units.en: On xinchou, prefects were ordered to recommend real talent, not fill quotas.
units.literal: Day xinchou, edict: circuit commissioners and prefects were each year to recommend officials and not merely fill quotas.

units.zh: 丙午，奉安仁宗御容于景靈宮。
units.en: On bingwu, Renzong's portrait entered Jingling Palace.
units.literal: Day bingwu: Renzong's portrait was installed at Jingling Palace.

units.zh: 丁未，白氣起西方。
units.en: On dingwei, white vapor rose in the west.
units.literal: Day dingwei: white vapor rose in the west.

units.zh: 五月癸亥，詔以綜核名實勵臣下。
units.en: Fifth month, guihai: edict to match name with deed and spur ministers.
units.literal: Fifth month, day guihai, edict: to synthesize names and reality to encourage ministers.

units.zh: 丙子，詔自今皇子及宗室屬卑者，勿授以檢校師、傅官。
units.en: On bingzi, honorary tutor posts were barred to low clan princes.
units.literal: Day bingzi, edict: from now on princes and lower-ranking imperial clan members were not to be given honorary tutor and steward posts.

units.zh: 乙酉，詔宗室封王者子孫襲爵。
units.en: On yiyou, enfeoffed princes' heirs would inherit their nobility.
units.literal: Day yiyou, edict: descendants of enfeoffed clan princes were to inherit their titles.

units.zh: 六月壬辰，錄囚。
units.en: Sixth month, renchen: prisoners were reviewed.
units.literal: Sixth month, day renchen: prisoners were reviewed.

units.zh: 己酉，詔尚書集三省、御史台議奉濮安懿王典禮。
units.en: On jiyou, the three departments and censorate would debate Pu rites.
units.literal: Day jiyou, edict: the Department of State Affairs was to convene the Three Departments and Censorate to deliberate rites for honoring Prince of Pu'an Yi.

units.zh: 甲寅，罷尚書省集議，令有司博求典故，務在合經。
units.en: On jiayin, the state conference was disbanded for a broader search for classical precedent.
units.literal: Day jiayin: the Department gathering was dissolved; relevant offices were to seek broadly for precedents, aiming at what fit the classics.

units.zh: 詔遣官與契丹定疆界。
units.en: Envoys were dispatched to delimit the Khitan border.
units.literal: Edict: officials were sent to fix the border with Khitan.

units.zh: 秋七月癸亥，富弼罷。
units.en: Seventh month, guihai: Fu Bi fell.
units.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day guihai: Fu Bi was dismissed.

units.zh: 丙寅，詔減乘輿服御。
units.en: On bingyin, the throne cut back imperial wardrobe.
units.literal: Day bingyin, edict: imperial carriage vestments were reduced.

units.zh: 丙子，放宮女百八十人。
units.en: On bingzi, one hundred eighty palace women were freed.
units.literal: Day bingzi: one hundred eighty palace women were released.

units.zh: 丁丑，太白晝見。
units.en: On dingchou, Venus shone in daylight.
units.literal: Day dingchou: Venus appeared by day.

units.zh: 己卯，群臣五上尊號，不允。
units.en: On jimao, ministers five times offered honorifics; he refused.
units.literal: Day jimao: the bureaucracy five times offered honorific titles; not accepted.

units.zh: 庚辰，張昪罷，以文彥博爲樞密使。
units.en: On gengchen, Zhang Bian fell and Wen Yanbo took military affairs.
units.literal: Day gengchen: Zhang Bian was dismissed; Wen Yanbo was made military affairs commissioner.

units.zh: 八月庚寅，京師大雨，水。
units.en: Eighth month, gengyin: the capital flooded.
units.literal: Eighth month, day gengyin: the capital had great rain and flood.

units.zh: 癸巳，賜被水諸軍米，遣官視軍民水死者千五百八十人，賜其家緡錢，葬祭其無主者。
units.en: On guisi, drowned troops and civilians were compensated and the ownerless buried.
units.literal: Day guisi: flood-hit armies were given grain; officials inspected one thousand five hundred eighty military and civilian drownings and granted their families cash; the unclaimed were buried and mourned.

units.zh: 乙未，以雨災，詔責躬乞言。
units.en: On yiwei, a rain-disaster edict confessed fault and sought remonstrance.
units.literal: Day yiwei: because of the rain disaster, an edict blamed the self and sought advice.

units.zh: 初，學士草詔曰：「執政大臣，其惕思天變。」
units.en: At first the draft read, "Chief ministers, heed Heaven's warning."
units.literal: At first the academicians drafted the edict: "Chief ministers, reflect on Heaven's warning."

units.zh: 帝書其後曰：「雨災專以戒朕不德，可更曰'協德交修'。」
units.en: He added in his own hand: "The rain warns only my want of virtue—say instead that we will cultivate virtue together."
units.literal: The emperor wrote after it: "The rain disaster is solely to warn me of lack of virtue—it should rather read 'join in cultivating virtue.'"

units.zh: 己亥，以水災，罷開樂宴。
units.en: On jihai, the flood canceled the Opening Music banquet.
units.literal: Day jihai: because of the flood, the Opening Music banquet was canceled.

units.zh: 壬子，以工部郎中蔡抗等充賀契丹生辰使，侍御史趙鼎等充賀契丹正旦使。
units.en: On renzi, Cai Kang's mission would greet the Khitan emperor's birthday; Zhao Ding's, New Year's Day.
units.literal: Day renzi: Ministry of Works director Cai Kang and others were sent as envoys to congratulate the Khitan emperor's birthday; investigating censor Zhao Ding and others as envoys for New Year's Day.

units.zh: 乙卯，減袞冕制度。
units.en: On yimao, twelve-symbol regalia was simplified.
units.literal: Day yimao: regalia for the twelve-symbol robe was reduced.

units.zh: 丙辰，陝西置壯城兵。
units.en: On bingchen, Shaanxi raised Stronghold troops.
units.literal: Day bingchen: Stronghold troops were established in Shaanxi.

units.zh: 九月壬戌，雨，罷大宴。
units.en: Ninth month, renxu: rain canceled the great feast.
units.literal: Ninth month, day renxu: rain; great banquet canceled.

units.zh: 己巳，以災異風俗策制舉人。
units.en: On jisi, the palace exam tested disaster-omens and local custom.
units.literal: Day jisi: metropolitan degree candidates were examined on disaster-omens and local customs.

units.zh: 壬午，太白犯南斗。
units.en: On renwu, Venus crossed the Southern Dipper.
units.literal: Day renwu: Venus invaded the Southern Dipper.

units.zh: 乙酉，以久雨，遣使祈于嶽瀆名山大川。
units.en: On yiyou, long rain sent prayers to sacred mountains and rivers.
units.literal: Day yiyou: because of prolonged rain, envoys were sent to pray at famous mountains and rivers.

units.zh: 冬十月乙巳，雨木冰。
units.en: Tenth month, yisi: glaze-ice weighed the trees.
units.literal: Winter, tenth month, day yisi: trees were coated with ice.

units.zh: 十一月庚午，朝饗景靈宮。
units.en: Eleventh month, gengwu: morning rites at Jingling.
units.literal: Eleventh month, day gengwu: morning offering at Jingling Palace.

units.zh: 辛未，饗太廟。
units.en: On xinwei, the ancestral temple was fed.
units.literal: Day xinwei: offering at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

units.zh: 壬申，有事南郊，大赦。
units.en: On renshen, the southern suburb and a great amnesty.
units.literal: Day renshen: the southern suburb rite was performed; great amnesty.

units.zh: 上皇太后冊。
units.en: The dowager received her book of investiture.
units.literal: The empress dowager's book was presented.

units.zh: 冊皇后。
units.en: The empress received her book of investiture.
units.literal: The empress was invested.

units.zh: 以齊州爲興德軍節度。
units.en: Qizhou became Xingde circuit.
units.literal: Qizhou was made Xingde army circuit.

units.zh: 辛巳，加恩百官。
units.en: On xinsi, officials received grace gifts.
units.literal: Day xinsi: grace was extended to the bureaucracy.

units.zh: 十二月辛亥，太白晝見。
units.en: Twelfth month, xinhai: Venus shone in daylight.
units.literal: Twelfth month, day xinhai: Venus appeared by day.

units.zh: 是歲，蔣、波、繡、雲、龍賜等州來貢。
units.en: That year, southwestern prefectures sent tribute.
units.literal: That year, Jiang, Bo, Xiu, Yun, Longxi, and other prefectures came with tribute.

units.zh: 三年春正月丙辰朔，契丹遣使耶律仲達等來賀正旦。
units.en: Year three, first month new moon bingchen: Khitan envoys came for New Year's Day.
units.literal: Year three, spring, first month, day bingchen new moon: Khitan sent envoy Yelü Zhongda and others to congratulate New Year's Day.

units.zh: 戊午，契丹遣使蕭惟輔等來賀壽聖節。
units.en: On wuwu, Khitan envoys came for Shousheng.
units.literal: Day wuwu: Khitan sent envoy Xiao Weifu and others to congratulate Shousheng festival.

units.zh: 丙寅，幸降聖院，謁神御殿。
units.en: On bingyin, he visited Jiangsheng Monastery and the spirit hall.
units.literal: Day bingyin: he visited Jiangsheng Monastery and paid respects at the spirit portrait hall.

units.zh: 癸酉，契丹改國號爲遼。
units.en: On guiyou, Khitan renamed itself Liao.
units.literal: Day guiyou: Khitan changed its state name to Liao.

units.zh: 己卯，溫州火，燒民屋萬四千間，死者五千人。
units.en: On jimao, a Wenzhou fire took fourteen thousand homes and five thousand lives.
units.literal: Day jimao: Wenzhou fire burned fourteen thousand civilian houses; five thousand dead.

units.zh: 丁丑，皇太后下書中書門下：「封濮安懿王宜如前代故事，王夫人王氏、韓氏、任氏，皇帝可稱親。
units.en: On dingchou, the dowager wrote: "Enfeoff Pu Yi by ancient precedent; the emperor might call Wang, Han, and Ren kin.
units.literal: Day dingchou: the empress dowager sent a letter to the Secretariat and Chancellor's Office: "Enfeoffment of Prince of Pu'an Yi should follow former-age precedent; Madames Wang, Han, and Ren—the emperor may call them kin.

units.zh: 尊濮安懿王爲皇，夫人爲後。」
units.en: Pu Yi was raised to emperor; his consorts to empresses."
units.literal: Prince of Pu'an Yi was honored as emperor; the ladies as empresses."

units.zh: 詔遵慈訓。
units.en: An edict obeyed her compassionate order.
units.literal: Edict: obey the compassionate instruction.

units.zh: 以塋爲園，置守衛吏，即園立廟，俾王子孫主祠事，如皇太后旨。
units.en: His tomb became a guarded park-temple, its rites led by his descendants as she wished.
units.literal: The tomb was made a park, guard officials set, a temple erected in the park, and the prince's descendants made to preside over sacrifice, as the empress dowager directed.

units.zh: 辛巳，詔臣民避濮安懿王諱，以王子宗懿爲濮國公。
units.en: On xinsi, Pu Yi's taboo was proclaimed and Zongyi made Duke of Pu.
units.literal: Day xinsi, edict: the people were to avoid the taboo of Prince of Pu'an Yi; his son Zongyi was made Duke of Pu.

units.zh: 壬午，黜御史呂誨、範純仁、呂大防。
units.en: On renwu, censors Lu Hui, Fan Chunren, and Lü Dafang fell.
units.literal: Day renwu: censors Lu Hui, Fan Chunren, and Lü Dafang were dismissed.

units.zh: 二月乙酉朔，白虹貫日。
units.en: Second month, new moon yiyou: a white halo cut the sun.
units.literal: Second month, day yiyou new moon: a white halo crossed the sun.

units.zh: 三月庚申，彗星晨見於室。
units.en: Third month, gengshen: a comet at dawn in the Room mansion.
units.literal: Third month, day gengshen: a comet appeared at dawn in the Room mansion.

units.zh: 辛酉，黜諫官傅堯俞、御史趙鼎、趙瞻。
units.en: On xinyou, Fu Yaoyu and censors Zhao Ding and Zhao Zhan fell.
units.literal: Day xinyou: remonstrance official Fu Yaoyu and censors Zhao Ding and Zhao Zhan were dismissed.

units.zh: 戊辰，上親錄囚。
units.en: On wuchen, he personally reviewed prisoners.
units.literal: Day wuchen: the emperor personally reviewed prisoners.

units.zh: 庚午，以彗，避正殿，減膳。
units.en: On gengwu, the comet drove him from the main hall and cut his meals.
units.literal: Day gengwu: because of the comet, he avoided the main hall and reduced meals.

units.zh: 辛未，以黜呂誨等詔內外。
units.en: On xinwei, an edict explained the dismissal of Lu Hui's party.
units.literal: Day xinwei: an edict to inner and outer on the dismissal of Lu Hui and others.

units.zh: 癸酉。
units.en: On guiyou, the third month turned toward mid-spring.
units.literal: Day guiyou.

units.zh: 以災異責躬，詔轉運使察獄訟、調役利病大者以聞。
units.en: Blaming himself for omens, he told transport commissioners to report on prisons and corvée abuses.
units.literal: Because of disaster-omens he blamed himself; edict: transport commissioners were to inspect prison cases and corvée assignments and report major abuses.

units.zh: 辛巳，彗晨見於昴，如太白，長丈有五尺。
units.en: On xinsi, a comet at dawn in the Pleiades blazed like Venus, fifteen chi long.
units.literal: Day xinsi: a comet appeared at dawn in the Pleiades, bright as Venus, fifteen chi long.

units.zh: 壬午，孛于畢，如月。
units.en: On renwu, a broom star at the Net glowed moon-bright.
units.literal: Day renwu: a broom star at the Net, like the moon.

units.zh: 夏四月丙午，詔有司察所部左道、淫祀及賊殺善良不奉令者，罪毋赦。
units.en: Fourth month, bingwu: officials must root out heterodox cults and lawless killers without mercy.
units.literal: Summer, fourth month, day bingwu, edict: officials were to investigate in their jurisdictions heterodox ways, illicit shrines, and those who killed the good and disobeyed orders—crime without pardon.

units.zh: 五月甲子，罷知雜御史、觀察使以上歲舉人。
units.en: Fifth month, jiazi: supervising censors and officials of observation commissioner rank or higher lost the right to make annual nominations.
units.literal: Fifth month, day jiazi: the posts of supervising censor and above and surveillance commissioners were stopped from annual recommendations.

units.zh: 乙丑，彗至張而沒。
units.en: On yichou, the comet reached Zhang and disappeared.
units.literal: Day yichou: the comet reached Zhang and vanished.

units.zh: 戊辰，謂宰相曰：「朕欲與公等日論治道，中書常務有定制者，付有司行之。」
units.en: On wuchen he told the cabinet: "Let us debate governance daily; routine papers can go to the clerks."
units.literal: Day wuchen: he told the chief ministers: "I wish to discuss the way of rule with you daily; routine Secretariat business with fixed regulations may be handed to the offices."

units.zh: 六月己酉，錄囚。
units.en: Sixth month, jiyou: prisoners were reviewed.
units.literal: Sixth month, day jiyou: prisoners were reviewed.

units.zh: 秋七月乙丑，進濮王子孫及魯王孫爵一等。
units.en: Seventh month, yichou: Pu and Lu princes' descendants rose one rank.
units.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day yichou: sons and grandsons of the Pu prince and the Lu prince were advanced one step in nobility.

units.zh: 八月庚子，遣傅卞等賀遼主生辰，張師顏等賀正旦。
units.en: Eighth month, gengzi: Fu Bian greeted the Liao emperor's birthday; Zhang Shiyan, New Year's Day.
units.literal: Eighth month, day gengzi: Fu Bian and others were sent to congratulate the Liao emperor's birthday; Zhang Shiyan and others for New Year's Day.

units.zh: 九月壬子朔，日有食之。
units.en: Ninth month, solar eclipse on renzi new moon.
units.literal: Ninth month, day renzi new moon: there was an eclipse of the sun.

units.zh: 癸亥，定待制、諫官、朝官少卿郎中遷選歲月補員格。
units.en: On guihai, rules were fixed for the promotion intervals and roster vacancies of palace attendants, remonstrance officials, court officials, vice directors, and directors.
units.literal: Day guihai: rules were fixed for years and months of advancement and replacement in the roster of awaiting-appointment officials, remonstrance officials, court officials, and vice directors and directors.

units.zh: 庚辰，禁妃嬪、公主以下薦服親之夫。
units.en: On gengchen, consorts and princesses could not peddle kin as husbands.
units.literal: Day gengchen, edict: consorts, princesses, and below were forbidden to recommend husbands among their kin by dress.

units.zh: 冬十月壬午朔，以仙游縣君任氏墳域爲園。
units.en: Tenth month, new moon renwu: his mother Lady Ren's tomb became a park.
units.literal: Winter, tenth month, day renwu new moon: Lady Ren of Xianyou's burial ground was made a park.

units.zh: 乙酉，詔兩日一御邇英閣。
units.en: On yiyou, he ordered Ziyi lectures every other day.
units.literal: Day yiyou, edict: court would be held at Ziyi Pavilion every two days.

units.zh: 丁亥，詔禮部三歲一貢舉。
units.en: On dinghai, the palace exam became triennial.
units.literal: Day dinghai, edict: the Ministry of Rites was to hold the metropolitan examination every three years.

units.zh: 甲午，詔宰臣、參知政事舉才行士可試館職者各五人。
units.en: On jiawu, each minister was to name five men fit for archive posts.
units.literal: Day jiawu, edict: chief ministers and vice commissioners were each to recommend five men of talent fit for archive posts.

units.zh: 十一月戊午，帝不豫，禱於大慶殿。
units.en: Eleventh month, wuwu: he sickened; prayers rose in Daqing Hall.
units.literal: Eleventh month, day wuwu: the emperor was unwell; prayers at Daqing Hall.

units.zh: 己未，宰相始奏事。
units.en: On jiwei, the cabinet at last reported affairs to him.
units.literal: Day jiwei: the chief ministers for the first time reported affairs.

units.zh: 辛酉，降天下囚死罪一等，流以下釋之。
units.en: On xinyou, death sentences dropped one grade; exiles and below went free.
units.literal: Day xinyou: death sentences empire-wide were reduced one degree; exile and below released.

units.zh: 十二月乙未，宰相祈于天地、宗廟、社稷。
units.en: Twelfth month, yiwei: ministers prayed at Heaven, temple, and altars.
units.literal: Twelfth month, day yiwei: the chief ministers prayed at Heaven, Earth, ancestral temple, and altars.

units.zh: 壬寅，立潁王頊爲皇太子。
units.en: On renyin, Ying prince Xu became crown prince.
units.literal: Day renyin: Prince of Ying Xu was established as crown prince.

units.zh: 癸卯，大赦。
units.en: On guimao, great amnesty.
units.literal: Day guimao: great amnesty.

units.zh: 賜文武官子爲父後者勳一轉。
units.en: Officials whose sons bore their line won one merit turn.
units.literal: Civil and military officials whose sons succeeded their fathers were granted one turn of merit.

units.zh: 遼遣蕭靖等來賀正旦、壽聖節。
units.en: Liao envoys came for New Year's Day and Shousheng.
units.literal: Liao sent Xiao Jing and others to congratulate New Year's Day and Shousheng festival.

units.zh: 是歲，遣使以違約數寇責夏國，諒詐獻方物謝罪。
units.en: That year, Xia was rebuked for treaty raids; Liangzuo sent apology gifts.
units.literal: That year: envoys were sent to reproach Western Xia for repeated border raids in violation of treaty; Liangzuo presented tribute to apologize.

units.zh: 四年春正月庚戌朔，群臣上尊號曰體乾膺曆文武聖孝皇帝。
units.en: Year four, first month new moon gengxu: ministers offered the full honorific title.
units.literal: Year four, spring, first month, day gengxu new moon: the bureaucracy offered the honorific From Heaven, Receiving the Calendar, Civil and Military, Sagely Filial Emperor.

units.zh: 降天下囚罪一等，徒以下釋之。
units.en: All crimes fell one grade; penal servants and below went free.
units.literal: Prisoners empire-wide had crimes reduced one degree; penal servitude and below released.

units.zh: 大風霾。
units.en: Dust storms again swept the land.
units.literal: Great wind and dust storms.

units.zh: 辛亥，蠲京師逋曲錢。
units.en: On xinhai, capital wine-shop arrears were forgiven.
units.literal: Day xinhai: overdue wine-shop debts in the capital were remitted.

units.zh: 丁巳，帝崩于福甯殿，壽三十六。
units.en: On dingsi, he died in Funing Hall at thirty-six.
units.literal: Day dingsi: the emperor died in Funing Hall; age thirty-six.

units.zh: 諡曰憲文肅武宣孝皇帝，廟號英宗。
units.en: Posthumous name: Sagacious Governance, Solemn Martiality, Proclaiming Filiality; temple name Yingzong.
units.literal: Posthumous title: Sagacious Governance, Solemn Martiality, Proclaiming Filiality Emperor; temple name Yingzong.

units.zh: 帝自居睦親宅，孝德著聞。
units.en: In the Mujin mansion his filial piety was legendary.
units.literal: When the emperor lived at the Mujin residence, filial virtue was renowned.

units.zh: 濮安懿王薨，以所服玩物分諸子，帝所得悉以與王府舊人既葬而辭去者。
units.en: At Pu Yi's death he shared the heirlooms, then gave his share to old household servants who had quit after the funeral.
units.literal: When Prince of Pu'an Yi died, he divided his personal effects among his sons; what the emperor received he gave entirely to old retainers of the mansion who had left after the burial.

units.zh: 宗室有假金帶而以銅帶歸，主吏以告，帝曰：「真吾帶也。」
units.en: A kinsman swapped a gold belt for copper; told of it, he said, "That is my belt."
units.literal: A clansman borrowed a gold belt and returned a copper one; the steward reported it, and the emperor said: "That is truly my belt."

units.zh: 受之。
units.en: He took it without fuss.
units.literal: He accepted it.

units.zh: 命殿侍鬻犀帶，直錢三十萬，亡之，帝亦不問。
units.en: He had a rhinoceros belt sold for three hundred thousand; when it vanished, he never asked.
units.literal: He ordered a hall attendant to sell a rhinoceros belt worth three hundred thousand cash; it was lost, and the emperor did not inquire.

units.zh: 初辭皇子，請潭王宮教授周孟陽作奏，孟陽有所勸戒，即謝而拜之。
units.en: Declining imperial sonship, he had Tan tutor Zhou Mengyang draft his memorial and bowed to Mengyang's rebuke.
units.literal: When he first declined the imperial-son appointment, he asked Zhou Mengyang, tutor of the Tan prince's palace, to draft the memorial; Mengyang offered admonition, and he thanked him and bowed.

units.zh: 奏十餘不允，始就召，戒舍人曰：「謹守吾舍，上有適嗣，吾歸矣。」
units.en: Ten refusals failed before he answered the call, telling staff: "Guard my rooms—an heir exists; I go home."
units.literal: More than ten memorials went unheeded before he accepted the summons; he warned the palace staff: "Guard my quarters carefully—there is already a proper heir; I am going home."

units.zh: 既爲皇子，慎靜恭默，無所猷爲，而天下陰知其有聖德。
units.en: As imperial son he was stillness itself, yet the realm sensed his sage virtue.
units.literal: Once imperial son, he was cautious, quiet, and reserved, doing nothing ostentatious, yet the empire quietly knew he bore sage virtue.

units.zh: 即位，每命近臣，必以官而不以名，大臣從容以爲言，帝曰：「朕雖宮中命小臣，亦未嘗以名也。」
units.en: He addressed even close attendants by office, not name—"Even palace pages get titles from me," he told the ministers.
units.literal: On succeeding to the throne, whenever he ordered a close attendant he used title, never personal name; when chief ministers gently remonstrated, the emperor said: "Even when I order a minor palace servant within, I never use the name."

units.zh: 一日，語神宗曰：「國家舊制，士大夫之子有尚帝女，皆升行以避舅姑之尊，義甚無謂。
units.en: He told Shenzong, "By old custom, when sons-in-law were promoted in rank to dodge a mother-in-law's seniority—it was a senseless twist of kinship.
units.literal: One day he said to Emperor Shenzong: "By old custom, when a scholar's son marries an imperial daughter, his rank is raised to avoid the mother-in-law's seniority—a meaningless twist of kinship.

units.zh: 朕嘗思此，寤寐不平，豈可以富貴之故，屈人倫長幼之序也？
units.en: I have brooded on it—how can wealth warp the order of elders and juniors?
units.literal: I have brooded on this, uneasy waking and sleeping—how can we bend the order of elder and younger for wealth and rank?

units.zh: 可詔有司革之。」
units.en: Let the offices reform it."
units.literal: Let the authorities reform it."

units.zh: 會疾不果，神宗述其事焉。
units.en: Illness stopped him; Shenzong finished what he began.
units.literal: Illness prevented it; Shenzong carried out his intent.

units.zh: 贊曰：昔人有言，天之所命，人不能違。
units.en: Praise: The ancients said what Heaven decrees, man cannot defy.
units.literal: Praise says: The ancients had a saying—what Heaven decrees, man cannot defy.

units.zh: 信哉！
units.en: Truly so!
units.literal: True indeed!

units.zh: 英宗以明哲之資，膺繼統之命，執心固讓，若將終身，而卒踐帝位，豈非天命乎？
units.en: Yingzong's clear mind took the succession yet he refused as if for life—and still became emperor. Was that not Heaven's mandate?
units.literal: Yingzong with his clear wisdom received the mandate to succeed, yet steadfastly declined as if for life, yet in the end ascended the throne—is this not Heaven's mandate?

units.zh: 及其臨政，臣下有奏，必問朝廷故事與古治所宜，每有裁決，皆出群臣意表。
units.en: In power he asked every memorial what precedent and antiquity required; his judgments consistently surprised the court.
units.literal: When he held government, whenever ministers memorialized he asked what court precedent and ancient governance required; each decision went beyond what ministers expected.

units.zh: 雖以疾疹不克大有所爲，然使百世之下，欽仰高風，詠歎至德，何其盛也！
units.en: Illness limited his deeds, yet posterity would admire and hymn his height—how grand!
units.literal: Though illness kept him from great deeds, he left a loftiness that a hundred generations would admire and hymn—how majestic!

units.zh: 彼隋晉王廣、唐魏王泰窺覦神器，矯揉奪嫡，遂啟禍原，誠何心哉！
units.en: Yet Sui's Yang Guang and Tang's Li Tai coveted the throne, twisted succession, and loosed disaster—what were they thinking?
units.literal: Yet Sui's Prince of Jin Guang and Tang's Prince Wei Tai coveted the vessel, twisted succession, and opened the floodgate of disaster—what were they thinking?

units.zh: 誠何心哉！
units.en: What hearts had they!
units.literal: What were they thinking!
